daemon.bind_address.description: IP address the daemon listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

daemon.port.description: TCP port for incoming LAM daemon connections.

paths.pid_file.description: Full path to the PID file for the daemon process.

daemon.log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

paths.log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to log to stdout.

daemon.ldap_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for LDAP operations before timing out.

daemon.ldap_use_tls.description: Whether to use STARTTLS for LDAP connections (recommended for production).

items.description: LDAP server URI(s). Use ldaps:// for SSL/TLS.

daemon.ldap_uris.description: Comma-separated list of LDAP URIs (servers) in order of preference.

ldap.basedn.description: Base DN where user and group entries are stored.

ldap.binddn.description: DN of the service account used to bind to LDAP.

ldap.bindpw.description: Password for the LDAP bind DN. In production, prefer secure credential storage.

ldap.schema_version.description: LDAP schema version supported by the server (e.g., RFC 2307, RFC 2307bis).

daemon.max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent incoming connections.

quota.mode.description: Quota enforcement mode: 'strict' (block over quota), 'soft' (warn but allow), or 'off' (disabled).

users.default_shell.description: Default login shell for new users.

users.uid_start.description: Starting UID number for new users.

users.gid_start.description: Starting GID number for new groups.

users.user_objectclass.description: Comma-separated list of objectClass values for user entries.

users.uid_attr.description: LDAP attribute used for user login names (e.g., 'uid', 'sAMAccountName').

users.cn_attr.description: LDAP attribute used for user/common-name display name.

users.group_cn_attr.description: LDAP attribute for group display name.

users.group_member_attr.description: LDAP attribute listing group members (e.g., 'memberUid' for RFC 2307, 'member' for RFC 2307bis).

ldap.follow_referrals.description: Whether to follow LDAP referrals (not recommended unless explicitly needed).

ldap.tls_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification. Leave empty to skip verification (not recommended).

ldap.sasl_mech.description: SASL mechanism for authentication (e.g., 'EXTERNAL'). Leave empty for simple bind.

daemon.restart_grace_period.description: Seconds to wait for in-flight requests to complete during service restart.

quota.scan_enabled.description: Enable background scanning to enforce quotas and update usage stats.

items.description: Group names to exclude from quota enforcement (e.g., system accounts).

quota.excluded_groups.description: List of LDAP group CNs that should not be subject to quota checks.
